name: neon
description: Manage serverless Postgres on Neon — projects, branches, schemas, SQL, migrations, Neon Auth, the Neon Data API, and docs — through the official remote Neon MCP server.

interface.shortDescription: Manage serverless Postgres on Neon through the official Neon MCP server.
interface.longDescription: The Neon skill exposes the official @neondatabase/mcp-server-neon as a single Fractal toolset, connecting to the remote endpoint at https://mcp.neon.tech/mcp over Streamable HTTP. Drive every Neon workflow from natural language: list / create / delete projects and organizations, branch and reset databases, run SQL (single statement or transaction), list tables, describe schemas, run safe two-phase migrations, fetch connection strings, profile slow queries with `EXPLAIN`, provision Neon Auth and the Neon Data API, and look up Neon docs. Authenticate via OAuth (default) or a `NEON_API_KEY` Bearer token. Scope the connection down with `?readonly=true`, `?projectId=<id>`, or `?category=querying&category=schema` for read-only or single-project safety.
defaultPrompt: Use the Neon skill whenever the task involves a Neon Postgres database — creating projects, branching, running SQL, migrating schemas, or fetching connection strings.
Always prefer the two-phase migration flow: `prepare_database_migration` on a temporary branch, then `complete_database_migration` to merge.
Append `?readonly=true` to the MCP URL whenever the task is purely read-only (inspecting schemas, running EXPLAIN, listing slow queries).
